right.title: Right to Safety
right.description: Protection against the marketing of goods and services that are hazardous to life and property.
right.example: A consumer should be protected from an unsafe electrical appliance that may cause injury or damage.

right.title: Right to be Informed
right.description: The right to be informed about the quality, quantity, potency, purity, standard and price of goods or services, as applicable.
right.example: Check the product label, maximum retail price, expiry date and required declarations before buying.

right.title: Right to Choose
right.description: Access, wherever possible, to a variety of goods and services at competitive prices.
right.example: A buyer should not be unfairly forced to purchase an unwanted add-on with a product.

right.title: Right to be Heard
right.description: The right to be heard and to be assured that consumer interests receive due consideration at appropriate forums.
right.example: A consumer can raise a grievance through an appropriate complaint channel and seek consideration.

right.title: Right to Seek Redressal
right.description: The right to seek redressal against unfair trade practices or restrictive trade practices, or unscrupulous exploitation of consumers.
right.example: Depending on the case, a Consumer Commission may order repair, replacement, refund or compensation.

right.title: Right to Consumer Education
right.description: The right to acquire the knowledge and skill to be an informed consumer throughout life.
right.example: Learn how to compare product details and understand complaint procedures before making a purchase.
